exercises.instruction: Put the verb into the correct form.

parts: I was very tired. I tried to keep my eyes open, but I couldn’t.
I tried
(keep) the shelf, but I wasn’t tall enough. (reach)
I rang the doorbell, but there was no answer. Then I tried
on the window, but there was still no answer. (knock)
We tried
the fire out, but without success. We had to call the fire brigade. (put)
Please leave me alone. I’m trying
. (concentrate)
Sue needed to borrow some money. She tried
Carl, but he didn’t have any. (ask)
Mr Bennett isn’t here right now. Please try
later. (call)
The woman’s face was familiar. I tried
where I’d seen her before. (remember)
If you have a problem with the computer, try
it. (restart)

exercises.instruction: For each description, write a sentence with need(s) + one of the following verbs: clean, cut, empty, paint, tighten

items.prompt: This room isn’t very nice. It needs painting.
answers: This room isn’t very nice. It needs painting.
